reviewer: Codex source review under maintainer instruction; not a human sign-off
review_method: Original public repository opened with Codex built-in web; pinned README and targeted implementation inspected through GitHub API; pinned raw bytes retrieved for hashes. No upstream project or paid model executed.
identity_check: Exact owner/name and numeric repository ID checked; site aliases and same-name repositories assessed separately.
role_findings_zh: 可见页面状态与有限操作、元素候选进入 Jev；Jev 选择操作及目标，代码验证并执行，文本另由小型模型生成。
role_findings_en: Visible page state and bounded operation/element candidates go to Jev; it selects the operation and target, code validates and executes, and a separate small model writes text.
limitations_zh: 航班演示及性能比较均为作者报告；未运行。网站两个旧 slug 指向同一仓库。
limitations_en: Flight demo and performance comparisons are author-reported and untested here. Two old website slugs point to the same repository.
